0022600122.text: The Heat, still winless at 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Dallas Mavericks, who are 1-2 and 10th in the West, and this is Miami's fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Dallas will be without six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
